SELECT examQuestionOption.* , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle FROM exam_question_option examQuestionOption LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionOption.question_id = examQuestion.id
ORDER BY examQuestionOption.sort_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_question_option examQuestionOption LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionOption.question_id = examQuestion.id

SELECT examQuestionOption.id , examQuestionOption.question_id AS questionId , examQuestionOption.option_key AS optionKey , examQuestionOption.option_content AS optionContent , examQuestionOption.sort_no AS sortNo , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle FROM exam_question_option examQuestionOption LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionOption.question_id = examQuestion.id
ORDER BY examQuestionOption.sort_no ASC

SELECT examQuestionOption.* , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle FROM exam_question_option examQuestionOption LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionOption.question_id = examQuestion.id WHERE examQuestionOption.id = #{id}
